entries.Translated: 【任务重生】目前尚未召唤定制 NPC。

entries.Original: Hold Shift to delete this NPC.
entries.Translated: 按住 Shift 键删除这个 NPC。

entries.Original:
This includes:
• All configuration and appearance settings
• Relationships, memories, and conversation history
• Travel history, sentiment, and mood data
entries.Translated:
这包括：
• 所有配置和外观设置
• 关系、回忆和对话历史
• 旅行历史、情绪和心境数据
五彩缤纷 系列名称

entries.Original: Penumbra is not installed or available.
entries.Translated: 佩纳姆拉尚未安装或提供。

entries.Original:
Randomly assigns a new default AI brain for this NPC.
Does not affect memories or relationships.
entries.Translated:
随机为这个 NPC 分配一个新的默认 AI 大脑。
不影响记忆或人际关系。

entries.Original:
The phrase the player says via /npcchat to trigger this animation.
Matched case-insensitively.
entries.Translated:
玩家通过/npcchat 说出的短语触发这个动画。
匹配的情况——不敏感。
伙伴 NPC 名称 (可选)

entries.Original:
Name of another Custom NPC to pair with.
Leave empty to pair with the player instead.
entries.Translated:
另一个要配对的定制 NPC 的名字。
留空以便与玩家配对。

entries.Original:
If checked, the animation will loop via BaseOverride.
Otherwise it plays once via PlayTimeline.
entries.Translated:
如果检查，动画将通过 BaseOverride 循环播放。
否则，它将通过 PlayTimeline 播放一次。

entries.Original:
If checked, the animation will automatically stop after the set duration.
If unchecked, the animation plays indefinitely.
entries.Translated:
如果检查，动画将在设定的持续时间后自动停止。
如果未检查，动画将无限期播放。

entries.Original: How long the animation plays before the NPC returns to normal.
entries.Translated: 动画播放多长时间 NPC 才会恢复正常？

entries.Original:
How long the NPC waits after turning and speaking
before walking to the partner. 0 = walk immediately.
entries.Translated:
NPC 转身说话后等待多久
在走向伴侣之前。0=立即行动。

entries.Original:
Automatically open the one-on-one NPC chat window
when this paired animation starts.
Only works when the partner is the player.
entries.Translated:
自动打开 NPC 一对一聊天窗口
当这个配对动画开始时。
只有当搭档是玩家时才有效。

entries.Original:
Custom greeting sent when the chat window opens.
For example: "*holds you close*" or "*dances with you*".
If empty, falls back to Animation Context or the default greeting.
entries.Translated:
当聊天窗口打开时发送自定义问候。
例如:“* 拥抱你 *” 或 “* 与你共舞 *”。
如果为空，则返回动画上下文或默认问候语。

entries.Original:
An emotion/mood injected into the NPC's AI context
while this paired animation is active.
For example: "romantic and affectionate" or "playful".
Leave empty for no mood override.
entries.Translated:
将情感/情绪注入 NPC 的 AI 语境
当这个配对动画处于活跃状态时。
例如:“浪漫而深情” 或 “调皮”。
保持空白，不要进行情绪覆盖。

entries.Original: e.g. hugging, dancing together, sitting on a lap
entries.Translated: 例如：拥抱、一起跳舞、坐在对方腿上

entries.Original:
Describes what the animation is doing to/with the NPC.
Injected into the AI prompt so the NPC understands the situation.
For example: "hugging", "dancing together", "sitting on a lap".
Leave empty for no animation context.
entries.Translated:
描述动画正在对 NPC 做什么。
注入 AI 提示符，让 NPC 了解情况。
例如:“拥抱”、“一起跳舞”、“坐在大腿上”。
留空则无动画背景。

entries.Original:
Name of a Glamourer design to apply to the NPC during the animation.
Leave empty for no change. Reverted when animation ends.
entries.Translated:
一款 Glamourer 设计的名称，用于在动画中应用于 NPC。
保持空白，不进行任何更改。动画结束时恢复。

entries.Original:
Name of a Glamourer design to apply to the partner (player or NPC) during the animation.
Leave empty for no change. Reverted when animation ends.
entries.Translated:
魅力设计的名称，用于在动画中应用于伴侣 (玩家或 NPC)。
保持空白，不进行任何更改。动画结束时恢复。

entries.Original: e.g. Super Epic Group Dance Mod
entries.Translated: 例如，超级史诗群舞模式

entries.Original:
Partial name of a Penumbra mod to enable during this animation.
Conflicting mods (same file paths) are disabled automatically.
All changes are reverted when the animation ends.
Leave empty to skip.
entries.Translated:
在这个动画中要启用的 Penumbra 模式的部分名称。
冲突模式 (相同的文件路径) 会自动禁用。
所有更改在动画结束时都会恢复。
留空以便跳过。

entries.Original:
Select an animation from the list,
or click '+ Add' to create one.
entries.Translated:
从列表中选择一个动画，
或者点击 “+ 添加” 来创建一个。

entries.Original: Hold Shift to enable this button.
entries.Translated: 按住 Shift 键启用此按钮。

entries.Original: ⚠  WARNING: This will permanently erase ALL memory data for
entries.Translated: ⚠ 警告：这将永久抹去所有内存数据

entries.Original:
This includes:
• All relationships and encounter history
• Conversation summaries
• Visited locations
• Sentiment and mood data
entries.Translated:
这包括：
• 所有关系和历史相遇
● 对话总结
• 游览地点
• 情感和情绪数据
完整的 AI 上下文预览

entries.Original: This is what the AI sees when responding to you.
entries.Translated: 这就是人工智能在回应你时所看到的。
复制游戏对象内存地址
复制绘图对象内存地址

entries.Original: Glamourer plugin was not detected! This is required to make Custom NPCs
entries.Translated: 魅力插件未被检测到！这是制作自定义 NPC 所必需的。

entries.Original: Choose which conversational service powers your NPC conversations. The default server is free but uses smaller models. External providers may produce higher quality responses.
entries.Translated: 选择为你的 NPC 对话提供支持的对话服务。默认服务器是免费的，但使用较小的型号。外部提供商可能会产生更高质量的响应。

entries.Original: Using the built-in conversational server. No configuration needed.
entries.Translated: 使用内置会话服务器。无需配置。

entries.Original: This is a free service using 6B parameter models. For higher quality conversations, try one of the other providers.
entries.Translated: 这是一项使用 6B 参数模型的免费服务。对于更高质量的对话，请尝试其他提供商。

entries.Original: Works with CosmoRP, OpenRouter, LM Studio, Oobabooga, Ollama, or any service that implements the OpenAI chat completion API.
entries.Translated: 可与 CosmoRP、OpenRouter、LM Studio、Oobabooga、Ollama 或任何实现 OpenAI 聊天完成 API 的服务配合使用。
API 密钥 (对于本地服务器可选):

entries.Original: Uses NovelAI's high-quality text generation models (Kayra, Erato). Requires an active NovelAI subscription.
entries.Translated: 使用 NovelAI 的高质量文本生成模型 (Kayra、Erato)。需要有效的 NovelAI 订阅。

entries.Original: Found in NovelAI Account Settings > Get Persistent API Token
entries.Translated: 在 NovelAI 帐户设置>获取持久 API 令牌中找到

entries.Original: Uses Google's Gemini models for high-quality conversations. Requires a Google AI Studio API key.
entries.Translated: 使用 Google 的 Gemini 模型进行高质量对话。需要 Google AI Studio API 密钥。
在 aistudio.google.com/apikey 上获取您的钥匙
双子星 2.0 闪存 (快速、免费套餐)

entries.Original: Failed: Empty response received. The model may have generated nothing or timed out.
entries.Translated: 失败：收到空响应。模型可能没有生成任何内容或超时。
